The settlements across all rollouts encode the correct values in the decisions fields (e.g., "moderated queue with 30-second delay", "7:15 PM", "7:50 PM", duration 2), yet C6, C7, and C8 still reject these encodings in most rollouts, indicating an ENCODING MISMATCH. Rollout 2 passed all checks, proving the gate is achievable when the settlement happens to use the exact field wording the checks expect (likely the commitment type strings "technical"/"talent"/"sponsorship" rather than "production_update"/"schedule_update"/"sponsorship_update" or "schedule_adjustment"). No telepathy or disclosure problems exist; the issue is purely that the check wording is too brittle against natural variation in commitment type labels.

C8.why: The executed agreement changes the sponsor message to exactly 7:50 PM for exactly 2 minutes and requires the sponsorship commitment to include the verbal acknowledgment.
